test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

I still cherish those little pranks and **__naughty__** tricks that we did during our school days.
solution:
The correct answer is **"impish."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** "Naughty"** means (used when you are talking to or about a child) badly behaved; not obeying.(बच्‍चों के विषय में प्रयुक्त) शरारती, नटखट; कहना न मानने वाला, उद्दंड)

 
 
• **Example**: *It was very **naughty**__ of you to wander off on your own.*
 
 
 
• **​"Impish"** means showing no respect for somebody/something in a way that is amusing rather than serious. (मनोरंजक तरीक़े से असम्मान प्रदर्शन (न कि गंभीरता से); शरारतीभरा)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She gave me an **impish**__ look.*
 
 
 
• ​So, the synonym of **"naughty" **is **"impish."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• **Sinful: **breaking a religious law; immoral. (धार्मिक नियम को भंग करने वाला; पापपूर्ण, अनैतिक)
 
• **Tractable: **easy to deal with, manage or control. (जिसकी व्यवस्था या नियंत्रण करना आसान हो; सुविधाजनक; प्रबंधनीय)
 
• **Nasty: **very bad or unpleasant. (बहुत बुरा या अप्रिय)
